_comment: NON-RUNNABLE INSTALLATION TEMPLATE for Codex CLI hooks. Codex loads hooks from a hooks.json or inline hook tables in its user configuration. Requires codex_hooks enabled. Replace both placeholders with verified absolute paths before installing; unrendered placeholders must never be deployed.
_paths_note: Replace @HESTIA_WORKSPACE@ and @HESTIA_PLUGIN_ROOT@ at install time. The public repository carries no operator-specific workspace path.
_witness_note: witness.py is the hook that reaches the daemon (hestia_begin_action + hestia_record_outcome); observe.sh only appends the raw event to a local file. Before #1133 only observe.sh was registered here, so no codex act ever reached the chain while the inventory read the member as governed.
